title: Patchthrough meeting notes
description: Notes the user typed during a recording. Their own words, never generated or rewritten. Timestamps are absolute wall clock on the same reference as audio_start in meta.json, not offsets, because the transcript's zero is not final until the recording stops.

at.description: ISO 8601 with milliseconds. Subtract audio_start from meta.json to place this note on the transcript's clock.
